name: nbp_rates-mcp
display_name: Narodowy Bank Polski - kursy walut MCP
description: Narodowy Bank Polski - kursy walut (market data): search_symbols, get_series. Every tool maps to a d

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Currencies of table A (average rates), with Polish names (dolar amerykański, euro ...); symbol is 'A/<code>' as get_series takes it. Table B (less common currencies) and C (bid/ask) series also work in get_series ('B/<code>', 'C/<code>').

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: PLN per unit of a currency for every fixing day from start to end (both REQUIRED, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 367 days apart). series_id is '<table>/<code>': A/USD, A/EUR, B/AED; table C gives the ask rate.
